[[File:Twin-Scented_Natterbloom.jpg|thumb|A Twin-Scented Natterbloom]]
The '''Twin-Scented Natterbloom''' was a rare medicinal herb native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. The plant exuded a pungent smell in its early growth, which changed during blooming season when the herb gave off a sweet citrus scent.

The [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] hoped that the Natterbloom may prove to be a cure of an ancient Drall disease, the [[Balding Sickness]]. Some victims resisted [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatment, forcing the Drall to search for alternate solutions. With the help of the local [[Dearic Garden Club]] and a helpful [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], the Drall ambassador to Talus [[Champhra Biahin]] was able to procure a sample of the Twin-Scented Natterbloom for further research.

==Behind the scenes==
The Twin-Scented Natterbloom is an item in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is only available during a small quest for the [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] [[Champhra Biahin]]. Biahin asks the player to deliver a sample of the herb to her. When the player travels to the designated coordinates and talks to the representative of the Dearic Garden Club, the item is placed in the player's inventory. Talking to Biahin again automatically removes the item from the inventory.

It is possible for players to talk to the Garden Club NPC, receive the item and then abort the mission in order to keep the item and use it for decoration or sell it to other players.
